Sam: Finance can approve if contingency is trimmed. Send exact line items and partner IDs.

Ava: Suggested split: SI enablement $65k, training/certs $20k, admin/contingency $25k. Will attach training plan to the ticket.

Nina: If partners were promised marketplace placement we may need addenda. Send affected list and comms draft; I can review in 48h.

MDF Bot: Ticket MDF-8199 created ("Q3 MDF reallocate - marketplace delay"). Status: pending_approval.

Priya: Ok — checklist: finance sign (Sam), legal note (Nina), partner council vote. If no objections by Fri 5pm PT I will trigger POs.

Reactions: Marco:+1, Sam:+1 (conditional), Ava:+1, Nina:pending.

Marco: I'll flag pending POs in ops sync.
